final: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS o FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, ev.avg_amount - overall.o AS beats_overall FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.o) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, beats_overall, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM above) AS gap_from_above_mean FROM above ORDER BY gap_from_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10
